case 01 opened: FCBC 8-K items 1.01, 8.01
First Community will buy Main Street Financial in an all-stock deal worth about $243M, about 27% of its own value
Buyer-side, all-stock: the price effect on FCBC is dilution against synergies, and the filing gives no accretion figures.
No mispricing to trade: a buyer-side bank deal at 1.8x book usually costs the buyer a little at the open, and that is not an edge
No accretion data; buyer-side reactions are small and quickly priced.
ANALYST objected: no trade
FCBC: no trade. An all-stock bank acquisition with no accretion figures
case 02 opened: SLS news
No data yet: SELLAS's Phase 3 REGAL trial passed its 80th event, which triggers the final analysis; results are still to come
A trial-timing milestone, not a result; the readout itself would be the event.
SLS: no trade. An event-count milestone, not trial data
case 03 opened: FELE news
Franklin Electric beat Q3 and nudged its 2026 EPS range up; it also agreed to buy Challenge Pumps for up to $195M
Mixed guide: EPS a little above consensus, sales below it.
No thesis: a Q3 beat with a full-year sales range that still sits below consensus implies a soft Q4
Q3 beat offset by a soft implied Q4.
Mixed guide: EPS a little above consensus, sales below it (SCOUT).
ANALYST objected: no trade
FELE: no trade. A Q3 beat with a soft implied Q4
